name: Smoke

patchlogs.name: Veilbreaker: Update 32
patchlogs.changes: Drifter eye FX will now be hidden when in the midst of the Smoke Screen ability.

patchlogs.name: Gara Prime: Hotfix 30.3.5
patchlogs.changes: Updated Color Palette titles for Smoke and Pride to be consistent with other Palette titles.

patchlogs.name: Fortuna: Hotfix 24.2.11
patchlogs.fixes:
Fixed a Smokefinger and Rude Zuud Memory Fragment having the same Codex image.
Fixed missing text in one of Smokefinger’s Memory Fragments.

patchlogs.name: Fortuna: Hotfix 24.2.8
patchlogs.changes: Stalker’s Smoke Screen ability now has a 20 second cooldown.

patchlogs.name: Fortuna: The Profit-Taker - Update 24.2
patchlogs.additions:
The residents of Fortuna may have opened up to you, but there is more story to be told. Venture though the Orb Vallis for Venus Lore Fragments (shaped similarly to Debt Tokens) to piece together the narratives of Eudico, The Business, Smokefinger, Legs, Rude Zuud, Little Duck, and Ticker.
FORTUNA SCENE (available from Smokefinger’s Offerings in Fortuna)

patchlogs.name: Fortuna: Hotfix 24.1.1 + 24.1.1.1
patchlogs.changes: Increased frequency of Rare Gems in Smokefinger’s Offerings.

patchlogs.name: Fortuna: Hotfix 24.0.9
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed certain MOA Companion parts not turning invisible when cloaked with a Warframe ability (i.e. Loki’s Invisibility, Ash’s Smokescreen, etc).

patchlogs.name: Fortuna: Hotfix 24.0.4
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed ambient VO not playing properly for Ticker and Smokefinger.

patchlogs.name: Fortuna: Hotfix 24.0.2
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed Cetus text appearing when Providing/Cutting Bait with Smokefinger.

patchlogs.name: Fortuna: Update 24.0
patchlogs.changes: Smokefinger also offers many other services such as purchasing Gems for Platinum, trading Gems for Solaris United Standing, and a lustrous list of Offerings available for purchase using Solaris United Standing:

patchlogs.name: Shrine of the Eidolon: Update 22.17.0 + 22.17.0.1
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed persisting muffled sound when casting Ash’s Smoke Shadow Augment as reported here: https://forums.warframe.com/topic/935041-smoke-screen-persisting-muffled-sound/

patchlogs.name: Shrine of the Eidolon: Update 22.15.0
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed Ash’s Smokescreen ending while in Operator causing sounds to be perpetually muffled when Transferring back to Ash.

patchlogs.name: Chains of Harrow: Hotfix 21.0.2
patchlogs.changes: Tweaked Ash’s Smoke Screen ability sound.

patchlogs.name: The War Within: Update 19.2.0
patchlogs.changes:
Ash’s Smoke Screen
Reduced the duration of Ash's Smoke Screen in Conclave.

patchlogs.name: The War Within: 19.1.0 Ash Revisited
patchlogs.changes:
Smoke Screen can now be cast while running (no lower body movement lock).
Smoke Screen can now be cast while in-air!

patchlogs.name: Update 19: The War Within
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed an issue with duplicate color options being visible on the Smoke Color Pallette.

patchlogs.name: The Silver Grove
patchlogs.changes: Decreased duration of Ash’s Smokescreen in Conclave

patchlogs.name: Update 18.3
patchlogs.changes: Ash’s Smoke Shadow Augment Mod now affects ally NPCs.

patchlogs.name: Update 18: The Second Dream
patchlogs.changes: Increased the duration of Ash’s Smokescreen in PvP.

patchlogs.name: Warframe: Sanctuary
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed Ash’s Smoke Shadow Augment Mod not functioning properly.

patchlogs.name: Update 15.9
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed Smoke colors in Arsenal selecting the same color twice unintentionally.

patchlogs.name: Hotfix 15.1.2
patchlogs.fixes:
Fixed an issue with Ash’s Smoke Shadow Augment lasting forever if cast by a client who subsequently quits the mission.
Fixed an issue with Ash’s Smoke Shadow affecting Defense targets.

patchlogs.name: Warframe: Archwing
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed Companions being completely invisible when under the effect of Ash's Smokescreen.

patchlogs.name: Update 14: The Mad Cephalon
patchlogs.changes:
Tweaked the sound effects for all Warframes entering Smoke Screen.
Improved the performance of Ash's Smoke Screen on lower end PC's.

patchlogs.name: Hotfix 9.3
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed Ash Smoke Screen VFX to last as long as the ability.

patchlogs.name: Hotfix 8.3
patchlogs.fixes: Fixed Ash’s Smoke Screen where he’d hold both melee and primary weapon.
